boundaries: Both co-primary must be considered with full matrices and correctly aligned Food/Service selectivity; positive difference det alone cannot show CueB itself has criterion directions.
Body primary requests B; CueA/B is donor-selector identity, not two requested actors in primary.
CueAll may contain A information even under own-body direct A-mask.
All-layer full-Cue K/V is an interface, not a single task vector or latent dimension/independent module.
Private prefixes preserved; name×world interaction, criterion-conditioned retrieval/calibration, fixed aspect order remain.
Recipient and donor full/candidate/conflict scores both reported.
Normalized observer zeros row norms≤.001 without dropping contexts; its scale must not hide tiny absolute responses.
Shared no/yes word surface cannot identify Source; other_source_word0 is not provenance isolation.
Native early/late is pure field order; independent early/late changes graph as well.
Only complete runs included; pending/partial runs not treated as negative or final confirmation.
